title: Fixed mark over a flickering image montage
summary: The brand mark holds dead centre while full-frame images swap under it every 2-6 frames, a 1 s loop of six looks run four times; mid-film the mark flips dark to light. A still mark over chaos is all the eye can hold.
use_when: A 3-5 s logo sting or bumper for a brand with a strong single mark
Showing the mark works on any background: photo, colour, light and dark
Silent loops for social feeds or event screens
Teasing a visual identity system (palette, imagery, device use) in one shot

look.type_style: no copy; only the mark, about 14 % of frame width, centred; tiny swatch labels (caps grotesk, ~2 % H) on the palette board

sfx.event: each background swap under the mark
mark colour flips dark to light at 2.10 s

structure.shot: dark field of floating mono rock shards, one large crystal in the centre carries the dark mark on a flat face
structure.camera: drift: push about 2 %/s (motion.json second 0), shard rotation slow
structure.motion: mark static at centre; shards drift, no entrance (film opens mid-motion)

structure.shot: montage: 6 shots, avg 0.15 s: glass phone in hands on grey (6 fr), its negative (3 fr), blue sky grid (3 fr), grey grid (3 fr), inverted planet rim (6 fr), 4-panel palette board (6 fr); dark mark
structure.camera: phone and grids static (±0.25 s); palette board pans left fast, ~470 px/s at 1920 (motion.json second 1)
structure.motion: hard swaps only, no entrances; the mark keeps the same centre and size through every cut (match-cut); per-shot holds 6/3/3/3/6/6 fr

structure.shot: montage: 7 shots, avg 0.14 s: cycle 2 repeats cycle 1 exactly, opening on the rock shards (3 fr); dark mark
structure.camera: same as cycle 1; palette board pans left, ~470 px/s at 1920
structure.motion: same 3/6/3/3/3/6/6 fr cadence; 1.00 s period, metronomic

structure.shot: montage: 6 shots, avg 0.16 s: cycle 3, shards then phone, negative phone, same images (sky grid fades to grey grid inside one 6 fr shot); mark now light/white
structure.camera: same as cycle 1; slight rotation on the shards (~5 deg/s, motion.json second 2)
structure.motion: mark colour flips dark to light inside the shard shot at 2.03-2.07 s (f61-62, between cut frames 2.00 and 2.07), no fade; negative phone 2 fr; cadence 3/6/2/6/6/6 fr

structure.shot: montage: 6 shots, avg 0.17 s: cycle 4 with the light mark: shards, phone, negative phone, sky-to-grey grid, planet rim, palette board
structure.motion: cadence 3/6/3/6/6/6 fr; mark fixed at centre

structure.shot: near-black flat frame with only the light mark centred (1 fr end)
structure.motion: none; the montage stops on the bare mark

params.brand: any brand.json: mark (needs a dark and a light variant), palette for the swatch board
params.content.images: 4 full-frame images: textured dark object field, light sky/grid, planet or landscape, any hero photo; one shot is a phone held in hands
params.content.swatches: 4 colours for the palette board (defaults to brand accent, light, dark, deepest)
params.timing.cadence: frames per shot in one cycle at 30 fps (default 3/6/3/3/3/6/6 = 30 fr)
params.timing.flipAt: frame where the mark switches to its light variant (default f61, start of cycle 3)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); cadence scales with it

notes: Measured from 26 hard cuts in cuts.json at 30 fps: a 30 fr cycle of 7 shots (3/6/3/3/3/6/6 fr), repeated 4 times; cycles 3-4 tighten slightly (2 fr negative frame). Mark never moves or scales: it is the anchor. Mark colour flips at f61-62 (between cut frames 2.00 and 2.07). Every second shot type is a 3 fr negative of the previous one, acting like a flash without white. Silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): anchored-mark-montage, negative-flicker.
